## Imported Garmin Data

```{r}
library(targets)

daily <- tar_read(daily_data)

str(daily, max.level = 2)
```

## Available Measurements

```{r}
library(tibble)

tibble(
  date = daily$date,
  sleep_available = !is.null(daily$sleep),
  stress_available = !is.null(daily$stress),
  body_battery_available = !is.null(daily$body_battery)
)
```
